rule: Finish all originally scheduled support arms with their original run IDs, order and configuration. Preserve each provider 5xx attempt without a submitted patch as ungraded with its original reservation. Do not replay or replace it. Collection after this incident can only close with a rejecting receipt. Report effects from the complete development and configuration panels, and descriptive available support outcomes with their actual denominators. The original release policy, test seal and no-rerun rule still apply.
